daily.love: If you're coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower today. Single? Someone's been lowkey noticing your energy. Either way, authenticity hits different when Scorpio brings it. Keep it 100.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is off the charts today. That project or idea you've been sitting on? The universe is basically giving you a gentle nudge to bring it to life. Small moves, big momentum.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding energy—think walks, hydration, touching grass. Mental clarity follows when you slow down. Rest isn't laziness; it's part of your strategy.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about shedding what no longer serves you. Mercury's vibes are pushing you toward honest conversations and authentic connections. Trust your intuition—it's been hitting different lately, and for good reason.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy from afar. Either way, this week asks you to show up as your real self, not the edited version you think people want.
